## Overview

Adds `recipes/models/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.yaml`, the MiniMax-M3.1-Flash serving recipe: single-node TP4 on AMD MI355X and NVIDIA Blackwell (verified on MI355X and GB200), plus 1P1D prefill/decode commands in the guide. Recipe only, split out of the model-support work so it can land on its own.

## Claims

- One `default` variant serves the `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` checkpoint (MXFP8 dense + NVFP4 experts) on every listed GPU. Per-brand flags live in the recipe-level `hardware_overrides`:
  - **AMD:** `indexer_decode_cp` and `--quantization-config.moe mxfp8` (AITER MXFP8 MoE), plus `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER` / `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS`.
  - **NVIDIA:** `use_prefill_query_quantization` and `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` CUDA graphs, plus `VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION=high`.
- DSpark spec decoding (the draft is in the checkpoint's `dspark/` folder, k=3) is on by default, with a per-brand draft attention backend: `FLASH_ATTN` on NVIDIA, `TRITON_ATTN` on AMD.
- The guide gives the exact 1P1D TP4 + TP4 NIXL commands for both MI355X and GB200. The MI355X prefill node also offloads KV to host memory through SimpleCPUOffload in 1 GiB HugeTLB pages.

## Validation

Schema and rendering, from a checkout of vllm-project/recipes at `origin/main` (7b006c1):

```bash
node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir ~/vllm/recipes
# ✓ vllm recipes from /Users/roy/vllm/recipes are valid against the renderer
```

The JSON API renders a command for each of mi355x, gb200, gb300, b200 and b300. The MI355X and GB200 renderings match the single-node commands in the guide. `pre-commit` passes.

## Details

- **Not a duplicate:** #63232 (MiniMax-M3.1-Flash model support) also adds this file. Its version targets GB300 only (DSpark k=7 with `FLASHINFER_TS`, DEP8). This PR carries the recipe on its own and adds MI355X and GB200. The two need to be reconciled before either merges: whichever lands second conflicts on the same path, and they currently disagree on active parameters (23B vs 26B), the DSpark k and draft backend, and the reasoning-mode kwarg (`reasoning_effort` vs `thinking_mode`).
- **Depends on unmerged code:** some rendered and guide commands use flags that are not on `main` yet. `indexer_decode_cp` (AMD single node and PD decode) comes with #63232. `cpu_hugepage_block_size` (MI355X PD prefill offload) is not in #63232 either. Those commands won't run on the current nightly until that code lands.
- **`precision_hardware: {}`:** the renderer assumes NVFP4 means NVIDIA Blackwell only. The empty override removes that assumption so one variant can cover MI355X too, and `supported_hardware` lists the eligible GPUs. Only MI355X and GB200 are marked `verified`.
- **`vram_minimum_gb`:** 533 GB by default (MI355X re-quantizes the experts to MXFP8), with a GB200 override of 285 GB (NVFP4 experts run natively).
- `pd_cluster` is left out of `compatible_strategies`. Its TP pools take the whole node and emit their own NixlConnector config, so the generated commands would not be the ones that were validated. PD stays in the guide.

## Overview

Adds `recipes/models/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.yaml`, the MiniMax-M3.1-Flash serving recipe: single-node TP4 on AMD MI355X and NVIDIA Blackwell (verified on MI355X and GB200), plus 1P1D prefill/decode commands in the guide. Recipe only, split out of the model-support work so it can land on its own.

## Claims

- One `default` variant serves the `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` checkpoint (MXFP8 dense + NVFP4 experts) on every listed GPU. Per-brand flags live in the recipe-level `hardware_overrides`:
  - **AMD:** `indexer_decode_cp` and `--quantization-config.moe mxfp8` (AITER MXFP8 MoE), plus `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER` / `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS`.
  - **NVIDIA:** `use_prefill_query_quantization` and `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` CUDA graphs, plus `VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION=high`.
- DSpark spec decoding (the draft is in the checkpoint's `dspark/` folder, k=3) is on by default, with a per-brand draft attention backend: `FLASH_ATTN` on NVIDIA, `TRITON_ATTN` on AMD.
- The guide gives the exact 1P1D TP4 + TP4 NIXL commands for both MI355X and GB200. The MI355X prefill node also offloads KV to host memory through SimpleCPUOffload in 1 GiB HugeTLB pages.

## Validation

Schema and rendering, from a checkout of vllm-project/recipes at `origin/main` (7b006c1):

```bash
node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir ~/vllm/recipes
# ✓ vllm recipes from /Users/roy/vllm/recipes are valid against the renderer
```

The JSON API renders a command for each of mi355x, gb200, gb300, b200 and b300. The MI355X and GB200 renderings match the single-node commands in the guide. `pre-commit` passes.

## Details

- **Not a duplicate:** #63232 (MiniMax-M3.1-Flash model support) also adds this file. Its version targets GB300 only (DSpark k=7 with `FLASHINFER_TS`, DEP8). This PR carries the recipe on its own and adds MI355X and GB200. The two need to be reconciled before either merges: whichever lands second conflicts on the same path, and they currently disagree on active parameters (23B vs 26B), the DSpark k and draft backend, and the reasoning-mode kwarg (`reasoning_effort` vs `thinking_mode`).
- **Depends on unmerged code:** some rendered and guide commands use flags that are not on `main` yet. `indexer_decode_cp` (AMD single node and PD decode) comes with #63232. `cpu_hugepage_block_size` (MI355X PD prefill offload) is not in #63232 either. Those commands won't run on the current nightly until that code lands.
- **`precision_hardware: {}`:** the renderer assumes NVFP4 means NVIDIA Blackwell only. The empty override removes that assumption so one variant can cover MI355X too, and `supported_hardware` lists the eligible GPUs. Only MI355X and GB200 are marked `verified`.
- **`vram_minimum_gb`:** 533 GB by default (MI355X re-quantizes the experts to MXFP8), with a GB200 override of 285 GB (NVFP4 experts run natively).
- `pd_cluster` is left out of `compatible_strategies`. Its TP pools take the whole node and emit their own NixlConnector config, so the generated commands would not be the ones that were validated. PD stays in the guide.

+guide: |
+  ## Overview
+
+  [MiniMax-M3.1-Flash](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) is a
+  vision-language MoE model from [MiniMax](https://www.minimax.io/) that keeps
+  the MoE architecture of [MiniMax-M3](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3):
+  about 428B total / 23B active parameters and a 1M-token context, with MSA
+  sparse attention in every layer.
+
+  - **Quantization-aware training** — the checkpoint stores MXFP8 dense layers
+    and NVFP4 experts.
+  - **Built-in DSpark draft** — the `dspark/` directory of the checkpoint;
+    `--speculative-config` needs no draft model path.
+  - **Native multimodal** — image and video inputs.
+
+  ## Prerequisites
+
+  - **AMD:** MI355X (gfx950), ROCm 7.2+, TP4.
+  - **NVIDIA:** GB200 (Blackwell), TP4 on half a node; NVFP4 MoE runs natively
+    on the FP4 tensor cores.
+  - **`--block-size 128` is mandatory** (MSA sparse/index cache).
+
+  ## Launching the Server
+
+  ### Single node (TP4, AMD MI355X)
+
+  ```bash
+  VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1 \
+  vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash \
+    -tp 4 \
+    --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
+    --block-size 128 \
+    --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4 \
+    --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "nvfp4", "indexer_decode_cp": true}' \
+    --quantization-config.moe mxfp8 \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"TRITON_ATTN","kv_cache_dtype":"fp8","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}' \
+    --disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager
+  ```
+
+  - `--kv-cache-dtype nvfp4` and `indexer_kv_dtype: nvfp4` store the KV cache
+    and the sparse-attention indexer's K cache in NVFP4.
+  - `indexer_decode_cp` splits the indexer's decode scoring across the TP ranks
+    by context instead of by index head.
+  - `--quantization-config.moe mxfp8` re-quantizes the NVFP4 experts to MXFP8 at
+    load for the AITER MoE.
+
+  ### Single node (TP4, NVIDIA GB200)
+
+  ```bash
+  VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION=high \
+  vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash \
+    -tp 4 \
+    --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
+    --block-size 128 \
+    --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4 \
+    --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "nvfp4", "use_prefill_query_quantization": true}' \
+    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}' \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"FLASH_ATTN","kv_cache_dtype":"fp8","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block"}' \
+    --max-num-seqs 256 \
+    --disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager
+  ```
+
+  - Blackwell runs the NVFP4 experts natively, so no
+    `--quantization-config.moe` override is needed.
+  - `use_prefill_query_quantization` quantizes the prefill query on the MSA
+    indexer path (Q8KV4).
+
+  ### Prefill/decode disaggregation (1P1D, TP4 + TP4, AMD MI355X)
+
+  Prefill node:
+
+  ```bash
+  VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1 \
+  VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=BLHNC VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST=<P_IP> \
+  vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash \
+    -tp 4 \
+    --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
+    --block-size 128 \
+    --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4 \
+    --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "nvfp4"}' \
+    --quantization-config.moe mxfp8 \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"TRITON_ATTN","kv_cache_dtype":"fp8","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}' \
+    --disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager \
+    --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 \
+    --port 8100 \
+    --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_connector_extra_config":{"connectors":[
+      {"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_producer","kv_connector_extra_config":{"num_threads":4}},
+      {"kv_connector":"SimpleCPUOffloadConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_connector_extra_config":{"cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank":601295421440,"cpu_hugepage_block_size":"1GB","lazy_offload":false}}]}}'
+  ```
+
+  Decode node:
+
+  ```bash
+  VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1 \
+  VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=BLHNC VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST=<D_IP> \
+  vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash \
+    -tp 4 \
+    --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
+    --block-size 128 \
+    --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4 \
+    --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "nvfp4", "indexer_decode_cp": true}' \
+    --quantization-config.moe mxfp8 \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"TRITON_ATTN","kv_cache_dtype":"fp8","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}' \
+    --disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager \
+    --port 8200 \
+    --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_consumer","kv_connector_extra_config":{"num_threads":4}}'
+  ```
+
+  - `<P_IP>` and `<D_IP>` are each node's own address, reachable from the
+    other node (the NIXL side channel).
+  - `VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=BLHNC` goes on both nodes. It keeps all layers of a
+    block contiguous, so NIXL reads one region per block instead of one per
+    layer.
+  - The prefill node never decodes, so it leaves `indexer_decode_cp` off.
+  - The prefill node also offloads KV to host memory
+    (`SimpleCPUOffloadConnector`): 560 GiB per rank in 1 GiB HugeTLB pages, so
+    2240 pages for the four ranks. Reserve them on the host before the start
+    (and allow them in the container's hugetlb limit), or the server fails at
+    startup with `Cannot map 560.00 GiB of 1024 MiB HugeTLB pages`:
+
+    ```bash
+    echo 2240 | sudo tee /sys/kernel/mm/hugepages/hugepages-1048576kB/nr_hugepages
+    ```
+
+  ### Prefill/decode disaggregation (1P1D, TP4 + TP4, NVIDIA GB200)
+
+  The NVIDIA pair runs NVFP4 KV end to end over NIXL (kv_buffer_device
+  `cuda`); the prefill node skips CUDA graphs (`--enforce-eager`) and carries
+  a 32768-token batch budget, the decode node runs FULL_DECODE_ONLY graphs.
+
+  Prefill node:
+
+  ```bash
+  VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION=high VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST=<P_IP> \
+  vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash \
+    -tp 4 \
+    --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
+    --block-size 128 \
+    --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4 \
+    --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "nvfp4"}' \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"FLASH_ATTN","kv_cache_dtype":"fp8","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block"}' \
+    --max-num-seqs 16 \
+    --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 \
+    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
+    --enforce-eager \
+    --port 8100 \
+    --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_producer","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_connector_extra_config":{"enforce_handshake_compat":false,"kv_lease_duration":120}}'
+  ```
+
+  Decode node:
+
+  ```bash
+  VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION=high VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST=<D_IP> \
+  vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash \
+    -tp 4 \
+    --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
+    --block-size 128 \
+    --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4 \
+    --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "nvfp4", "use_prefill_query_quantization": true}' \
+    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"FLASH_ATTN","kv_cache_dtype":"fp8","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block"}' \
+    --max-num-seqs 88 \
+    --max-num-batched-tokens 512 \
+    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
+    --disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager \
+    --port 8200 \
+    --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_consumer","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_connector_extra_config":{"enforce_handshake_compat":false,"kv_lease_duration":120}}'
+  ```
+
+  For a quick test, put the toy NIXL proxy from the vLLM repository in front of
+  the two nodes and send requests to port 8000:
+
+  ```bash
+  python tests/v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/toy_proxy_server.py --port 8000 \
+    --prefiller-host <P_IP> --prefiller-port 8100 \
+    --decoder-host <D_IP> --decoder-port 8200
+  ```
+
+  ## Client Usage
+
+  Recommended sampling parameters (from the model card): `temperature = 1.0`,
+  `top_p = 0.95`. Set the reasoning effort per request with
+  `chat_template_kwargs: {"reasoning_effort": "<level>"}`: `low`, `medium`,
+  `high`, `xhigh` or `max`.
+
+  ```bash
+  curl http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions \
+    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+    -d '{
+      "model": "MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash",
+      "temperature": 1.0,
+      "top_p": 0.95,
+      "messages": [
+        {"role": "user", "content": "Explain MSA sparse attention in 3 bullets."}
+      ]
+    }'
+  ```
+
+  ## Benchmarking
+
+  ```bash
+  vllm bench serve \
+    --backend vllm \
+    --model MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash \
+    --endpoint /v1/completions \
+    --dataset-name random \
+    --random-input 8192 \
+    --random-output 1024 \
+    --max-concurrency 32 \
+    --num-prompts 320
+  ```
+
+  ## Troubleshooting
+
+  - **`--block-size` mismatch.** MSA's sparse block size is 128; the vLLM KV
+    cache block size must match (otherwise `No common block size for 16`).
+  - **Parsers.** `--tool-call-parser` and `--reasoning-parser` both use
+    `minimax_m3`.
+  - **HugeTLB pages (PD prefill node).** See the PD section above.
+
+  ## References
+
+  - [Model card](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash)
+  - [MiniMax-M3 recipe](https://recipes.vllm.ai/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3)
+  - [MiniMax](https://www.minimax.io/)

When a generated command is run from a source/nightly build of this commit, `indexer_kv_dtype` resolves to `nvfp4`, but `select_indexer_impl_cls` explicitly raises `NotImplementedError` for both `mxfp4` and `nvfp4` because the CuteDSL implementation is “not-yet-added” (`vllm/models/minimax_m3/common/indexer.py:533-536`). This setting is shared by every NVIDIA command and repeated for AMD, so even the advertised single-node path cannot complete startup; land that backend first or use a supported indexer dtype.

+    --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4 \
+    --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "nvfp4", "indexer_decode_cp": true}' \
+    --quantization-config.moe mxfp8 \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"TRITON_ATTN","kv_cache_dtype":"fp8","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}' \
+    --disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager
+  ```
+
+  - `--kv-cache-dtype nvfp4` and `indexer_kv_dtype: nvfp4` store the KV cache
+    and the sparse-attention indexer's K cache in NVFP4.
+  - `indexer_decode_cp` splits the indexer's decode scoring across the TP ranks
+    by context instead of by index head.
+  - `--quantization-config.moe mxfp8` re-quantizes the NVFP4 experts to MXFP8 at
+    load for the AITER MoE.
+
+  ### Single node (TP4, NVIDIA GB200)
+
+  ```bash
+  VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION=high \
+  vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash \
+    -tp 4 \
+    --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
+    --block-size 128 \
+    --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4 \
+    --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "nvfp4", "use_prefill_query_quantization": true}' \
+    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}' \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"FLASH_ATTN","kv_cache_dtype":"fp8","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block"}' \
+    --max-num-seqs 256 \
+    --disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager
+  ```
+
+  - Blackwell runs the NVFP4 experts natively, so no
+    `--quantization-config.moe` override is needed.
+  - `use_prefill_query_quantization` quantizes the prefill query on the MSA
+    indexer path (Q8KV4).
+
+  ### Prefill/decode disaggregation (1P1D, TP4 + TP4, AMD MI355X)
+
+  Prefill node:
+
+  ```bash
+  VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1 \
+  VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=BLHNC VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST=<P_IP> \
+  vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash \
+    -tp 4 \
+    --reasoning-parser minimax_m3 \
+    --block-size 128 \
+    --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4 \
+    --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "nvfp4"}' \
+    --quantization-config.moe mxfp8 \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":3,"attention_backend":"TRITON_ATTN","kv_cache_dtype":"fp8","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}' \
+    --disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager \
+    --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 \
+    --port 8100 \
+    --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MultiConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_connector_extra_config":{"connectors":[
+      {"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_producer","kv_connector_extra_config":{"num_threads":4}},
+      {"kv_connector":"SimpleCPUOffloadConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_connector_extra_config":{"cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank":601295421440,"cpu_hugepage_block_size":"1GB","lazy_offload":false}}]}}'
